<?php
/**
 * IoT Device Firmware - OAuth2 Authorization Controller
 * Handles device pairing and role-based access for smart home hub
 * Version: 2.4.1
 */

namespace IoTHub\Auth;

use IoTHub\Core\DeviceRegistry;
use IoTHub\Core\SessionManager;
use IoTHub\Core\CryptoUtils;

class OAuthController
{
    private const ALLOWED_SCHEMES = ['https'];
    private const MAX_REDIRECT_LENGTH = 2048;
    private const ROLE_HIERARCHY = [
        'device_admin' => 4,
        'device_user' => 3,
        'device_viewer' => 2,
        'device_guest' => 1
    ];

    private $registeredClients;
    private $sessionManager;
    private $auditLog;

    public function __construct(DeviceRegistry $registry, SessionManager $session)
    {
        $this->registeredClients = $registry->getOAuthClients();
        $this->sessionManager = $session;
        $this->auditLog = new \IoTHub\Core\AuditLogger('/var/log/iothub/oauth.log');
    }

    /**
     * Validates redirect URI against registered client configuration
     * Implements RFC 6749 Section 3.1.2 requirements
     */
    private function validateRedirectUri(string $clientId, string $redirectUri): bool
    {
        if (strlen($redirectUri) > self::MAX_REDIRECT_LENGTH) {
            return false;
        }

        $parsed = parse_url($redirectUri);
        if ($parsed === false || !isset($parsed['scheme']) || !isset($parsed['host'])) {
            return false;
        }

        // Enforce HTTPS-only for redirect URIs
        if (!in_array(strtolower($parsed['scheme']), self::ALLOWED_SCHEMES, true)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Fragment component MUST NOT be included (RFC 6749 3.1.2)
        if (isset($parsed['fragment'])) {
            return false;
        }

        $client = $this->registeredClients[$clientId] ?? null;
        if ($client === null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Match against registered redirect URIs using normalized comparison
        return $this->uriMatchesRegistered($redirectUri, $client['redirect_uris']);
    }

    /**
     * Performs normalized URI comparison per RFC 6749
     * Uses component-wise matching to prevent bypass via encoding tricks
     */
    private function uriMatchesRegistered(string $uri, array $registeredUris): bool
    {
        $normalizedInput = $this->normalizeUri($uri);

        foreach ($registeredUris as $registered) {
            $normalizedRegistered = $this->normalizeUri($registered);
            if ($this->compareNormalized($normalizedInput, $normalizedRegistered)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Normalizes URI components for secure comparison
     */
    private function normalizeUri(string $uri): array
    {
        $parts = parse_url($uri);
        $parts['scheme'] = strtolower($parts['scheme'] ?? '');
        $parts['host'] = strtolower($parts['host'] ?? '');
        // Normalize port - remove default ports
        if (isset($parts['port'])) {
            if ($parts['scheme'] === 'https' && $parts['port'] === 443) {
                unset($parts['port']);
            }
        }
        // Normalize path - decode unreserved characters, then re-encode
        $parts['path'] = $this->normalizePath($parts['path'] ?? '/');
        return $parts;
    }

    /**
     * Path normalization with percent-encoding handling
     */
    private function normalizePath(string $path): string
    {
        // Decode percent-encoded unreserved characters (RFC 3986 2.3)
        $decoded = rawurldecode($path);
        // Remove dot segments
        $decoded = $this->removeDotSegments($decoded);
        return $decoded;
    }

    private function removeDotSegments(string $path): string
    {
        $output = [];
        $segments = explode('/', $path);
        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '..') {
                array_pop($output);
            } elseif ($segment !== '.') {
                $output[] = $segment;
            }
        }
        return implode('/', $output);
    }

    /**
     * Compares two normalized URI component arrays
     */
    private function compareNormalized(array $input, array $registered): bool
    {
        // Scheme must match exactly
        if ($input['scheme'] !== $registered['scheme']) return false;
        // Host must match exactly after lowercasing
        if ($input['host'] !== $registered['host']) return false;
        // Port must match (absence = default)
        $inputPort = $input['port'] ?? null;
        $regPort = $registered['port'] ?? null;
        if ($inputPort !== $regPort) return false;
        // Path comparison - use prefix matching for registered wildcard paths
        return $this->pathMatches($input['path'] ?? '/', $registered['path'] ?? '/');
    }

    /**
     * Path matching with support for registered path prefixes
     * A registered path of /callback matches /callback exactly
     * A registered path ending in /* matches any sub-path
     */
    private function pathMatches(string $inputPath, string $registeredPath): bool
    {
        if (substr($registeredPath, -2) === '/*') {
            $prefix = substr($registeredPath, 0, -2);
            return strpos($inputPath, $prefix) === 0;
        }
        return $inputPath === $registeredPath;
    }

    /**
     * Authorization endpoint - handles device pairing requests
     */
    public function authorize(array $request): array
    {
        $clientId = $request['client_id'] ?? '';
        $redirectUri = $request['redirect_uri'] ?? '';
        $responseType = $request['response_type'] ?? '';
        $scope = $request['scope'] ?? '';
        $state = $request['state'] ?? '';

        // Validate client exists
        if (!isset($this->registeredClients[$clientId])) {
            $this->auditLog->warning('Unknown client_id', ['client_id' => $clientId]);
            return ['error' => 'invalid_client', 'status' => 401];
        }

        // Validate response type
        if ($responseType !== 'code') {
            return ['error' => 'unsupported_response_type', 'status' => 400];
        }

        // Validate redirect URI
        if (!$this->validateRedirectUri($clientId, $redirectUri)) {
            $this->auditLog->warning('Invalid redirect_uri', [
                'client_id' => $clientId,
                'redirect_uri' => $redirectUri
            ]);
            return ['error' => 'invalid_redirect_uri', 'status' => 400];
        }

        // Validate requested scope against client's allowed roles
        $requestedRole = $this->scopeToRole($scope);
        $maxRole = $this->registeredClients[$clientId]['max_role'] ?? 'device_guest';
        if (!$this->isRoleAllowed($requestedRole, $maxRole)) {
            return $this->buildRedirectError($redirectUri, 'invalid_scope', $state);
        }

        // Generate authorization code
        $code = CryptoUtils::generateSecureToken(32);
        $this->sessionManager->storeAuthCode($code, [
            'client_id' => $clientId,
            'redirect_uri' => $redirectUri,
            'scope' => $scope,
            'role' => $requestedRole,
            'expires' => time() + 600
        ]);

        return [
            'redirect' => $redirectUri . '?code=' . urlencode($code) . '&state=' . urlencode($state),
            'status' => 302
        ];
    }

    private function scopeToRole(string $scope): string
    {
        $mapping = [
            'admin' => 'device_admin',
            'control' => 'device_user',
            'read' => 'device_viewer',
            'basic' => 'device_guest'
        ];
        return $mapping[$scope] ?? 'device_guest';
    }

    private function isRoleAllowed(string $requested, string $maxAllowed): bool
    {
        $reqLevel = self::ROLE_HIERARCHY[$requested] ?? 0;
        $maxLevel = self::ROLE_HIERARCHY[$maxAllowed] ?? 0;
        return $reqLevel <= $maxLevel;
    }

    private function buildRedirectError(string $uri, string $error, string $state): array
    {
        $separator = (strpos($uri, '?') !== false) ? '&' : '?';
        return [
            'redirect' => $uri . $separator . 'error=' . urlencode($error) . '&state=' . urlencode($state),
            'status' => 302
        ];
    }
}
